profile.headline: Software Engineer at University of Pittsburgh

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Led development of Pitt-GPT-Plus, a fully local RAG chatbot (FastAPI + React), building a hybrid vector
+ knowledge graph retrieval pipeline with an answer accuracy of 95% or more.
• Containerized the system with a multi-stage Docker build with NGINX + Supervisor, with persistent volumes and an
idempotent admin-bootstrap routine on startup.
• Engineered and evidence-grounded answer-verification gate scoring each generated sentence against retrieved context with
automatic repair/clarify fallbacks to reduce unsupported/hallucinated outputs improving accuracy by 29%.
• Designed and built a 35-endpoint REST API in FastAPI with JWT authentication, bcrypt password hashing and role-based access
control (admin-gated and user-gated routes).
• Hardened the platform with 70+ automated tests covering authentication, authorization guards, and database migration

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Designed and deployed a real-time warehouse control and inventory system in Python, processing sensor
feedback for 10,000+ SKUs.
• Integrated motion tracking logic via sensor arrays, automating object tracking.
• Optimized database queries and Python control logic, reducing latency by 20%.
• Collaborated with hardware teams to test and refine sensor feedback loops, simulating real-world ML input systems
• Application has further developmental growth that is being researched and tested
positions.insights: Skills: PostgreSQL · Quality Assurance · Python (Programming Language)

positions.title: Test Engineer
positions.description:
• Tested and validated autonomous vehicle control software in both simulated and real-world environments.
• Deployed navigation software on embedded platforms, executing fail-safe routines and fault injection scenarios.
• Reported anomalies and collaborated on fixes with C++ developement teams; strengthened reliability protocols.
positions.insights: Skills: C++ · Computer Simulations · Functional Testing

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
• Built Python pipelines for robotic sensor data ingestion and processing for autonomous inspection systems.
• Integrated camera feeds with control systems, processing image metadata for downstream ML tasks.
• Developed a JSON-to-subtitle parser in JavaScript for user-friendly visualization of robot actions.
positions.insights: Skills: Artificial Intelligence (AI) · JavaScript · Machine Learning · Scikit-Learn · Python (Programming Language) · Computer Science

positions.title: PRODUCTION ENGINEER INTERN
positions.description:
•	Designed and implemented an application of managing the floor stock inventory. Along with taking the leadership role to manage other interns to organize the inventory and confirm the application is running smoothly.
•	Use data structure for inventory management

•	Organized two hackathons with a small team of people. Recruited sponsors, presented ideas for the activities taking place at the event, and assisted teams with executing their ideas for the hackathon.

positions.title: Hacker
positions.description: •	Our team developed an SMS based alert system and web application using Java, Twilio, and Google’s Cloud ML text-to-speech service for hospital discharge procedure

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description: •	Worked on projects to improve and find ways to connect the mechanical components by implementing Raspberry Pi.

positions.title: SOFTWARE ENGINEER INTERN
positions.description:
•	Worked in a small group to introduce and implement facial recognition with Java and Raspberry Pi into customer service. 
•	Data analysis of retail c-store sales data, create algorithm to predict sales and patterns.

educations.schoolName: University of Pittsburgh School of Computing and Information

projects.title: Cat Tracking and Mapping
projects.description:
• Developed a multi-camera motion detection system using OpenCV and Python to track and classify pet
movement throughout a home.
• Implemented a lightweight object classification model to distinguish pet cat movement from other motion
with 90% accuracy.
• Mapped detected motion events to a 2D blueprint of the house, visualizing the cat’s nightly path and room
occupancy patterns.
• Attempting to implement behavioral analysis by storing time-stamped path data, aiding in detection of
unusual or idle patterns along with eating tendencies.

projects.title: Object Tracking and Pedestrian Detection
projects.description:
• Developed a robust object tracking and motion detection system using Kalman and Particle filters, combined
with Hierarchical Lucas-Kanade optical flow.
• Preprocessed images to enhance object detection; extracted centroids and motion vectors with >92% tracking
accuracy across varying lighting and occlusion scenarios.
• Classified pedestrian motion with an 88% success rate on custom-labeled datasets.
